title: Serve share links on freq.ie and add a Shorter link switch to the share panels

source.ref: Daniel request 2026-11-02, parked until the Irish registration documents are done

detail: Short share links work on frequencylocal.com/s/<code> (LIVE-1960). Daniel bought freq.ie for an even shorter form and parked it: it needs Irish registration documents he does not have yet. freq.ie is already added to the frequency-web Vercel project and shows Invalid Configuration; its DNS is not set. The finished code is in the history of PR 4448, commit ad89c35: a short-link host in lib/sites/host.ts (freq.ie/<code> rewrites to /s/<code>, the bare host goes to frequencylocal.com, www goes to the bare host, anything else is a 404), the /s route building its redirect on Frequency's own origin, a shorterLinkFor helper, and an off-by-default Shorter link switch on the event, Space and listing share panels. To finish: set the Vercel redirect on freq.ie to none and www.freq.ie to a 308 to freq.ie; at the registrar delete parking records, add an A record @ to 216.150.1.1 and a CNAME www to d4bc968f91cd136b.vercel-dns-017.com. (values from Vercel's own recommendation for this project, checked 2026-11-02); wait for Valid Configuration on both rows; re-apply the commit; re-record the authz digest of app/s/[slug]/route.ts.
